name: mamas-oven-website
description: Mama's Oven artisan bakery catalog website with WhatsApp ordering and product gallery

scripts.start: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');http.createServer((q,s)=>{let p=path.join('.',q.url==='/'?'index.html':q.url.split('?')[0]);if(fs.existsSync(p)&&fs.statSync(p).isFile())fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(s);else s.writeHead(404).end('Not found');}).listen(3000,()=>console.log('Mama’s Oven site running at http://localhost:3000'));"

author: Mama's Oven
